source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Separate debt adjudication,appeals and recovery-certificate execution

payload.title: Identify the order before selecting an appeal
payload.core_explanation_md:
The RDB framework separates the original adjudication of debt,the appellate tribunal route and execution through the Recovery Officer. An appeal from the original tribunal and a challenge to a Recovery Officer order have different provisions and deposit analysis. Do not use one percentage or forum merely because both are called appeals.

Jurisdiction,limitation,procedure,certificate corrections,recovery modes and priority also need their own text. Keep the exact order,the decision-maker,the receipt date and the relief sought. The same loan can generate several stages without making their procedural requirements interchangeable.

self_check.prompt_text: Why identify who made the order?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The challenge route and conditions depend on the decision and stage.

payload.stem_md: A file challenges a Recovery Officer order but automatically uses the tribunal-to-DRAT appeal provision. What is needed?

options.explanation_md: It does not establish the route.

options.text_md: The specific Recovery Officer challenge provision and its conditions
A rule that no recovery order can ever be challenged

payload.stem_md: A debt has been adjudicated and a certificate issued. Why distinguish recovery execution from deciding the original claim again?

options.text_md: A certificate automatically authorises every possible act
The borrower name no longer matters
The Recovery Officer operates within the execution framework and powers
options.explanation_md: Adjudication and execution have distinct provisions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Adjudication and execution have distinct provisions.
